title: Exchanges & Returns
body:
At Equator Stores, we want you to shop with confidence. If your purchase doesn't meet your expectations, our exchange guidelines are designed to make the process straightforward.

01. In-Store Purchases

  • Items can be exchanged within 10 days of purchase, subject to the conditions below.
  • The original purchase receipt must be presented.
  • Products must be unworn, unused and unwashed, with original tags and packaging intact.
  • Exchanges will be processed at the prevailing selling price.
  • Discounted merchandise is eligible for size exchange only, subject to availability.
  • Fragrances, undergarments and accessories are not eligible for exchange.

02. Online Orders

Online purchases may be exchanged within 10 days of delivery through either of the following methods:

Visit an Equator Store

  • Bring your item along with the original invoice or order confirmation.
  • Our team will assist with the exchange, subject to product availability and the applicable conditions.

Request an Exchange by Courier

  • Contact our customer support team with your order number and exchange request.
  • Follow the return instructions provided by our team.
  • Ensure the item is securely packed with its original tags and packaging.
  • Once received and inspected, the exchange will be processed, subject to availability.

03. Damaged or Incorrect Deliveries

Your order should reach you in perfect condition. If you receive a damaged, defective or incorrect item:

  • Notify our customer support team within a day of receiving your order.
  • Share your order details and photographs showing the issue.
  • Following verification, return shipping will be arranged at Equator's expense.
  • A replacement or suitable resolution will be offered after inspection.

04. Important Information

  • All purchases are non-refundable.
  • Items must meet the stated exchange conditions.
  • Exchanges are subject to stock availability.
  • Sale merchandise qualifies for size exchange only.
  • Items excluded from exchange include fragrances, undergarments and accessories.

05. Need Assistance?

For exchange requests or further assistance, our customer support team is available to help.
